CVE-2026-109349.title: gitoxide gix-pack before 0.75.0 contains a reachable assertion in ...
CVE-2026-109349.description: gitoxide gix-pack before 0.75.0 contains a reachable assertion in BytesToEntriesIter::new_from_header: the pack header decoder accepts version 3, but a release-enabled assert_eq! requires version 2. A malicious remote can send a 12-byte pack header declaring version 3 to panic the client and abort the clone or fetch.

CVE-2026-109350.title: Gitoxide gix-pack before 0.75.0 contains a denial of service vuln ...
CVE-2026-109350.description: Gitoxide gix-pack before 0.75.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows malicious remotes to crash fetch operations by sending crafted thin-pack OFS_DELTA entries. Attackers can serve a thin pack with a REF_DELTA referencing an existing object followed by an OFS_DELTA whose base_distance exceeds pack_offset, triggering a panic in LookupRefDeltaObjectsIter that aborts the fetch process.

CVE-2026-109351.title: Gitoxide gix-pack before 0.75.0 contains an uncontrolled memory a ...
CVE-2026-109351.description: Gitoxide gix-pack before 0.75.0 contains an uncontrolled memory allocation vulnerability that allows remote attackers to abort the process by supplying a huge pack-header object count. Malicious remotes can serve a 12-byte pack header claiming 0xFFFFFFFF objects, forcing Tree::with_capacity to reserve hundreds of gigabytes and crash clone or fetch operations.

CVE-2026-82254.title: gitoxide before 0.69.0 contains unchecked array indexing in delta ...
CVE-2026-82254.description: gitoxide before 0.69.0 contains unchecked array indexing in delta application and uncapped allocation from attacker-controlled size headers in gix-pack. Attackers can send crafted pack data during clone or fetch operations to trigger panics or out-of-memory process kills.
